summary: Create unique hairstyles, makeup, and manicures with Rainbow High dolls
description:
Step into the world of Rainbow High and turn every character into a fashion superstar! In Rainbow High: Beauty Salon, boys and girls can style hair, decorate nails, apply makeup, and create trendy outfits. Organize photoshoots, share your designs, and watch your Rainbow High dolls shine. Perfect for any young stylist.

Hair Color & Styling
Unleash your creativity! Try wavy, straight, curly, or braided hairstyles, or go for a bold new cut. Change hair colors to match any look and make your Rainbow High characters extra stunning. Every hairstyle is a tiny masterpiece!

Makeup & Skincare
Give your dolls dazzling makeovers with lipstick, eyeshadow, blush, and spa treatments. Create natural looks or full glam — your characters are your canvas.

Nails & Pedicure
No look is complete without fabulous nails! Choose colors, patterns, and sparkles to bring out your characters’ personality. A bright polish or a hint of shimmer can add a touch of glamour!

Outfits & Accessories
Dress your characters for casual days, parties, or high-fashion moments. Mix and match clothes, shoes, bags, and accessories to bring your boldest ideas to life. Rainbow High Beauty Salon is your runway!

Photos & Style Showcases
When your masterpiece is ready, organize a photoshoot! Save, share, and showcase your creations — or keep them as a memory of your amazing transformations.
 
Creative Play Benefits:
 • Inspire creativity with endless fashion combinations
 • Easy, kid-friendly controls for boys and girls
 • Explore casual, dressy, bold, and unique styles
 • Save and share your favorite creations

Start creating stunning looks today! Boys and girls can make their Rainbow High characters colorful, stylish, and one-of-a-kind — where every choice adds a touch of fashion magic.
